items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions Frank Johnson, but the interviewee does not respond with any personal connection or memory regarding him.

ctx.x: Would you describe what the band was like and some of the people that may have been in the band?
I didn't know anything about Frank Johnson until I came to New York and they sent for him to come -
He said the band that was playing at Eighty-One. Do you remember any of the people that were in it?
